verdict.rationale: CDP runs some processes automatically in the background: deposit addresses auto-credit custodial accounts with optional auto-liquidation, and incoming USDC can be auto-converted to USD. Real-time webhooks let developers trigger their own event-driven automations, and the Agentic Wallet CLI lets AI agents hold and spend funds on their own. However, there is no user-configurable automation layer, so autonomous workflows must be built and hosted by the user on top of webhooks, the SDK and agent tooling. Missing for 10: scheduled or recurring payouts, a first-party rules/workflow builder for background automations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
